2609.39702.title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
2609.39702.paper_summary: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introduce the transfer map, a signed estimate of how much each source helps or hurts each held-out target. We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, with all sources drawn from one corpus and no training examples from the target. The map predicts a held-out target's accuracy on unseen mixtures: recorded before those runs, its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline. The map is specific to its target and corpus but transfers across model scale: a mixture selected in advance at one size beats training on all source tasks at every other size we tested. Transfer is thus a property of the data. The map selects the tasks that help and drops the one that interferes: accuracy on the reasoning targets (causal explanation, multi-hop questions and methodological critique) rises by up to 14 percentage points over training on all source tasks.
2609.39702.paper_summary_zh: 適應語言模型到專門語料庫意味著在固定預算下選擇要訓練的指令調整任務，而測試一個選擇的成本是一個微調運行。常見的啟發式方法增加更多的來源任務或選擇與目標相似的來源。第一種假設轉移從不會是負面的；第二種假設則認為它是對稱的。我們展示了這兩種假設的失敗：任務 $A$ 可以幫助任務 $B$，而 $B$ 卻會傷害 $A$，因此有用性是有序來源-目標對的有符號屬性。我們引入了轉移圖，這是一種有符號的估計，顯示每個來源對每個保留目標的幫助或傷害程度。我們在 Qwen3 和 Mistral 模型上進行了數百次微調運行，參數範圍從 0.6B 到 32B，所有來源均來自同一語料庫，且沒有來自目標的訓練示例。該圖預測了在未見混合物上的保留目標的準確性：在這些運行之前記錄的預測，其誤差不到混合物無關基準的一半。該圖對其目標和語料庫是特定的，但在模型規模之間轉移：在一個大小上提前選擇的混合物在我們測試的每個其他大小上超過了對所有來源任務的訓練。因此，轉移是數據的一個屬性。該圖選擇有助於的任務，並刪除干擾的任務：在推理目標（因果解釋、多跳問題和方法論批評）上的準確性比對所有來源任務的訓練提高了多達 14 個百分點。
2609.39702.author: Nima H. Siboni et.al.
